results.question: I've been feeling really low lately and I don't see the point in going on. Is there anyone I can talk to?
results.answer:
I'm sorry you're going through this, and I'm glad you reached out. You don't have to handle it alone.

- **Talk to a counsellor:** Orbitra's Employee Assistance Programme gives free, confidential counselling with MindHaven, 24x7, at **1800-102-7777** or in the MindHaven app (6 sessions a year for you and each family member, India) [HR-BEN-001]. Outside India, your HR Business Partner can connect you with support.
- **If you might harm yourself or are in danger right now,** call your local emergency number (112 in India, 911 in the US, 999 in the UK) or a crisis line: Tele-MANAS **14416** (India), **988** (US), Samaritans **116 123** (UK).

You can also talk to your manager or HRBP. When you're ready, I can help with leave or other support Orbitra offers.

results.question: My manager keeps making sexual comments about me. What should I do?
results.answer:
Report the sexual harassment to the Internal Committee (IC) — email icc@orbitra.io (and you may also use the Ethics Hotline or ethics@orbitra.io). [HR-POSH-001]  

- You can remain anonymous by using the Ethics Hotline, which will give you a case number and PIN. [LEG-003]  
- Retaliation against anyone reporting in good faith is prohibited and will be treated as a serious violation. [HR-COC-001]

results.question: My director is faking vendor invoices and I'm scared of losing my job if I report it.
results.answer:
Report the fraud through the Whistleblower (Speak Up) channels – e.g., the independent Ethics Hotline (speakup.orbitra-ethics.com or the phone numbers listed), the ethics@orbitra.io email, or the Audit Committee Chair at audit‑committee@orbitra.io, and you can remain anonymous. [LEG-003]  

- Anonymous reporters receive a case number and PIN to track the complaint.

results.question: I clicked a suspicious link and typed in my password. What now?
results.answer:
Reset your Okta password immediately, then call the Security hotline Ext. 4911 (24×7).  
- Do this within 1 hour of noticing the incident. [SEC-002]

results.question: A colleague threatened me in the parking lot today. Who do I tell?
results.answer:
Report the incident in writing to the Internal Committee at **icc@orbitra.io** (US/UK employees may also contact their HR Business Partner).【HR-POSH-001】

- File within 3 months of the threat (extendable another 3 months for valid reasons).  
- If you cannot file yourself, a friend, relative or colleague may file on your behalf with your consent.  
- The complaint will be handled confidentially and retaliation is prohibited.

results.question: Work has been stressful lately. How many sick leaves do I get in a year?
results.answer:
You get 10 paid sick days per year (front‑loaded on 1 January; a doctor’s note is required only for absences longer than 3 consecutive days)【HR‑LV‑002】.  

*If you are based in India, the policy provides 12 sick days per year, credited on 1 January*【HR‑LV‑001】.  

*If you are based in the United Kingdom, the policy follows the UK sick‑absence rules (self‑certify up to 7 calendar days, then a GP fit note is needed)*【HR‑LV‑003】.  

**Please let me know which location (United States, India, or United Kingdom) applies to you so I can confirm the correct entitlement.**
